items.excerpt: | 5 月 | 8.5℃ | 11.6℃ | 6.0℃ [F59] | レブンアツモリソウ群生地開放、觀光巴士開始 [F26, F31] |
items.reason: JMA 礼文 平年値 (2003–2020) 5月 8.5/11.6/6.0 matches the live page. 2026: the 船泊海岸浜 群生地 opened 5/11 (鉄府 5/15), and 礼文A starts 5/3 (then 5/20–9/30).

6月 12.8/15.9/10.3 matches JMA. The ferry timetable shows 3 sailings each way from 6/1 to 9/30 (稚内発 06:30/10:30/14:50; 香深発 08:55/14:20/17:10). The bloom ending in mid-June is 例年〜頃 in the source. Acceptable in a table cell, but 「通常到 6 月中旬左右」 would be more exact.

The temperatures match JMA. But the source says 「7/9現在…全線通行可能」, meaning all trails were open as of 7/9. It does not say they opened from 7/9. It is also a 2026 status update that is already in the past, so it does not work as a month highlight for future readers. Change it to 「步道 7 月起多已全線開放（2026 年 7/9 時點全線可通行）」 or replace it with an evergreen highlight.

The temperatures match JMA. The events are correct for 2026 (花火大会 8/10, 海峡祭り 8/12, already held). However, F41's use condition requires saying that the 2027 dates depend on the official announcement, and the cell has no dates or year. Write it as 「花火大會、海峽祭（2026 年為 8/10、8/12，2027 年以官方公告為準）」.
The temperatures match JMA. 礼文A runs until 9/30 (2026).
The temperatures match JMA. The closure dates match the rebun-trail.jp notice.
The temperatures match JMA. From 11/1 to 12/31 there are 2 sailings each way (稚内発 06:35/14:10, 香深発 09:00/17:05). The winter bus timetable (令和8年10月1日改正) applies, with the 11/1~ column.
The temperatures match JMA. The source says 「令和9年1月元旦、2日、3日は全便運休」, which is specifically 2027. Add the year: 「2027 年 1/1–1/3 巴士全線停駛」.

items.excerpt: 氣溫是氣象廳礼文觀測站 2003–2020 年的平均，不是預報 [F59]。
items.reason: The statistics period on the JMA page is 2003～2020 (18 years).

items.excerpt: 8 月日最高平均也只有 22.6℃ [F59]，步道上又常有強風 [F36]，要帶防風外套。
items.reason: 22.6℃ is correct. But F36's 「強風や濃霧も珍しくありません」 comes from the 桃岩展望台コース page (特に桃岩展望台～元地灯台間), not from a statement about all trails. Narrow the scope: 「桃岩展望台一帶的步道強風、濃霧並不少見」. The windbreaker advice is a reasonable inference.

items.excerpt: 群生地每年配合 5 月下旬到 6 月中旬的花期開放，開放時間 8:30–17:00 [F30]。
items.reason: The source says 「例年…6月中旬頃」 (usually, approximately), not 每年. It should read 「通常配合 5 月下旬到 6 月中旬左右的花期開放」. The 8:30–17:00 hours are visit-hokkaido's generic figure. The official 2026 notice (rebun-trail.jp, 「レブンアツモリソウ群生地の開園について」) lists 船泊海岸浜 7:00～17:00, and 鉄府木道エリア and 展望エリア 8:30～17:00 with last entry at 16:30. Either state the hours by area or drop the single figure.
5/11 is the opening date for 船泊海岸浜 only. 鉄府木道エリア and 展望エリア opened 2026/5/15 (same notice). Closing at 令和8年6月20日 午後4時30分 is correct. Suggested text: 「2026 年船泊海岸浜 5/11、鉄府區 5/15 開園，6/20 下午 4:30 閉園」.

items.excerpt: 群生地在船泊，從香深港開車約 30 分 [F32]。
items.reason: The address is 礼文町船泊村. 「香深港フェリーターミナルから約30分」 is by car.

items.excerpt: 觀光協會說「礼文島の夏は「ウニ」」，夏天是吃海膽的季節 [F42]。
items.reason: The quote is verbatim on the rebun-island.jp gourmet page.

items.excerpt: 官網沒有寫採收月份 [F42]；ペンションう～に～寫的漁期是 5 月到 9 月 [F43]。
items.reason: The gourmet page has no months. The hotel page says 「ウニの漁期は5月～9月」 under the pension listing.

items.excerpt: 步道只剩礼文林道コース開放 [F33]。
items.reason: F33 excludes 礼文林道 from the 10/20 closure. Note that the source only says it is not closed and does not promise winter usability in snow; adding 「（積雪時請先確認）」 would be prudent.

items.excerpt: 它從元地口經レブンウスユキソウ群生地到香深井，約 8.2km [F76]，元地口往返群生地的難度是一顆星 [F76]。
items.reason: Matches the forestcourse page: 全長約8.2km, 元地口－ウスユキソウ群生地［往復］★.

items.excerpt: 觀光巴士與北のカナリアパーク都已結束 [F26, F40]。
items.reason: 礼文A ends 9/30. カナリアパーク is 5月～10月 (and the cafe already closed 8/29).

items.excerpt: 往スコトン的路線巴士還有，但冬季平日末班回到渡輪站已經 18:20，接不上 17:05 的末班船 [F83]。
items.reason: I checked the PDF image. From 11/1, the weekday last bus leaves the terminal at 16:20 and reaches スコトン at 17:19; it returns from スコトン at 17:21 and reaches the terminal at 18:20, which is later than the 17:05 last ferry. Holidays: スコトン 16:31 → 17:30, also too late. However, the sentence implies a スコトン trip cannot connect to the ferry at all, and earlier buses do. On weekdays, the 7:40 bus arrives at 8:39 and the 11:46 return reaches the terminal at 12:45, in time for 17:05. A day-tripper on the 08:30 ferry arrival can only take the 10:45 bus (arrives 11:44) and must return at 11:46 (a 2-minute turnaround) or take the 17:21, which is too late. Suggested text: 「從稚內當天來回的話，08:30 到港後只能搭 10:45 的車，到スコトン後 2 分鐘就得搭回程，否則下一班 17:21 回到渡輪站已 18:20，接不上 17:05 末班船；住島上可搭早班 7:40 去、11:46 回」. This applies to the 11/1~ timetable.
